summary: Bergia Frites is a family-owned company based in Roermond, Netherlands, that makes frozen fries and other frozen potato products. It began as a potato and egg trading business in 1931. It started processing potatoes in the mid-1960s and has made frozen fries since the mid-1980s.
products: Frozen fries: Shoestring, Straight Cut, Steakhouse, Crinkle Cut
facts: 1931: Harry Meeuwissen starts Fa. Meeuwissen in Sint Odiliënberg, trading potatoes and eggs
Mid-1960s: processing begins with pre-fried, chilled fries
Early 1970s: first automatic production line; the name Bergia Frites is adopted
Mid-1980s: frozen fries added alongside chilled products
2011: chilled production stopped; the range became frozen only
